name: Sunpatch
summary: A greenhouse sign-in where a sunflower turns to follow your typing and folds her petals shut for your password
about: Four linked screens for a garden journal app called Sunpatch: sign in, start a patch, reset password with a 6-digit code, and a signed-in garden with today's tasks. Sunny the sunflower grows out of her pot under a glass greenhouse roof; she turns her face toward your caret, folds her front petals over her face for the password and opens three of them when you show it. A wrong password makes her wilt under a little rain cloud, a stronger new password grows five pots of herbs on the bench, and she spins into full bloom when you get in.
how: Watch Sunny practise the demo login on her own, then click any field to take over
Type an email: her face turns to follow the caret and she bounces with each key; a known address gets a leaf wave
Click the password: her petals fold shut; press the eye button and three petals open for a peek
Try a wrong password to see her wilt under a rain cloud, or turn on Caps Lock and the bee starts racing around
Press Type it for me, or sign in with hina@sunpatch.garden and bloom2026, for the full bloom and your task list
On Start a patch each password rule grows a pot of mint, chilli, tomato, marigold or basil; Reset password plants the demo code 640218 in her pot
